# Reconciliation (generated by `_build/reconcile.py`)

Every number below was computed from `data/raw` (plain Python) and again from `data/clean` (pandas); all 69 values are equal (rel. tolerance 1e-9). Report cards and DAX titles must match this file. Amounts in assumed INR.

## Headline numbers

| # | Measure | Value | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Revenue | ₹1.10 Cr (11,009,308.50) | SUM(order_total) |
| 2 | Orders | 5,000 | COUNTROWS(fact_orders) |
| 3 | Average order value | ₹2,201.86 | Revenue / Orders |
| 4 | Customers ordering | 2,172 | DISTINCTCOUNT(customer_id) in orders (customers.csv has 2,500) |
| 5 | Repeat rate | 68.7% | customers with 2+ orders / customers ordering |
| 6 | On-time % | 69.4% | delivery_status = On Time (includes up to 5 min late); late % = 30.6% |
| 7 | Avg minutes late | 4.44 | mean of minutes_late, early counts negative; 14.49 among late orders |
| 8 | Avg rating | 3.34 | mean rating 1-5 |
| 9 | Poor-experience rate | 45.8% | late OR rating <= 2 |
| 10 | Revenue at Risk | ₹50.42 L (5,042,193.50) | revenue of poor-experience orders = orders x poor rate x AOV of those orders; with overall AOV: ₹50.40 L |

## Forecast and levers (re-derived with plain Python loops from data/clean; `_build/forecast.py` output must match)

Naive (last full month) model, rolling-origin backtest (train 10 to 13 months, forecast 6): MAPE 2.77%. Forecast = ₹5.38 L a month for Nov 2024 to Dec 2025; 2025 total ₹64.52 L; last 12 full months ₹66.60 L (-3.1%).

| Lever (basis Nov 2023 to Oct 2024) | Annual value |
|---|---|
| Cut late deliveries by 5 points | ₹2.64 L (264,407) |
| Cut 1-2 star ratings by 5 points | ₹2.31 L (230,693) |
| Move 20% of App spend to Email | ₹67,456 (67,456) |
| Cut stock damage by 0.5 points | ₹43,325 (43,325) |
